definition: χαριτόω, -ῶ (χάρις), [in LXX: Sir.18:17 (ἀνδρί κεχαριτωμένῳ; Vg., justificato; Syr., saintly) * ;] to endow with χάρις (which see), i.e.  __1. (a) to make graceful;  __(b) to make gracious (Sir, l.with).  __2. In Hellenistic writings (for exx., see AR, Eph., 227; Lft., Notes, 315),  __(a) to cause to find favour;  __(b) to endue with grace (i.e. divine favour): Luk.1:28, Eph.1:6.† (AS)
